experiment: Long-workload confirmation of remaining-Prefill blocking without a global TTFT reserve
reason_for_followup: The diagnostic 677-condition back-check showed that the global 5% TTFT reserve reduced unsafe approvals only from 4 to 3 but increased conservative rejections from 47 to 151 when combined with remaining-Prefill blocking. Therefore the global reserve is rejected as a general mechanism, and the blocking correction is confirmed separately.

baseline_comparison.note: Baseline was already executed on the exact same h104/h106 population with unchanged J0 core and standard reference; do not rerun it solely to waste compute.

success_questions: Does remaining-Prefill blocking keep false acceptance at zero on the long population?
Does it reduce false rejection below 14?
What happens to sampled maximum-safe-load edges?
